plain_english: Neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.
sanskrit_cite: etannāyoginījāto nārudro labhate sphuṭam hṛdayaṃ devadevasya sadyo yogavimokṣadam |

plain_english: At its right speaking, the great mantra-seal host comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.
sanskrit_cite: asyoccāre kṛte samyaṅmantramudrāgaṇo mahān sadyastanmukhatāmeti svadehāveśalakṣaṇam |

plain_english: Who remembers for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds then all, body and mantra-seal host, the man.
sanskrit_cite: muhūrta smarate yastu cummakenābhimudritaḥ saṃbadhnāti tadā sarvaṃ mantramudrāgaṇaṃ naraḥ |

plain_english: Asked, he tells past and future things — even within a watch, uttering the meant god-form.
Face to face he sees the sure, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-standing, remembering.
sanskrit_cite: sākṣātpaśyatyasaṃdigdhamākṛṣṭaṃ rudraśaktibhiḥ praharadvayamātreṇa vyomastho jāyate smaran |

plain_english: By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.
sanskrit_cite: trayeṇa mātaraḥ sarvā yogeśvaryo mahābalāḥ vīrā vīreśvarāḥ siddhā balavāñcchākinīgaṇaḥ |

plain_english: They come, pledge got, by Bhairava urged — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.
sanskrit_cite: āgatya samayaṃ labdhvā bhairaveṇa pracoditāḥ yacchanti paramāṃ siddhiṃ phalaṃ yadvā samīhitam |

plain_english: By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect; whatever is in Bhairava's Tantra, all succeeds from this.
sanskrit_cite: anena siddhāḥ setsyanti sādhayanti ca mantriṇaḥ yat kiñcidbhairavetantre sarvamasmāt prasidhyati |

plain_english: Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.
sanskrit_cite: adṛṣṭamaṇḍalo'pyevaṃ yaḥ kiñcidvetti tattvataḥ sa siddhibhāg bhavennityaṃ sa yogī sa ca dīkṣitaḥ |
